decisions.reason: The vacuum thermoforming unit builds directly on the firm's existing dental equipment and digital manufacturing knowledge, and its continued own-page presence indicates the firm can interpret customer feedback and improve it.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the firm's core dental and hearing expertise and customer base, limiting its ability to assimilate market feedback and apply new knowledge, so it is more likely to be dropped.
The post-curing unit aligns closely with the firm's digital production and materials know-how, enabling the firm to recognise and apply early results, so it will likely be kept.
